notes:
Research notes (today is Oct 12, 2026, so "20 years ago" means the 2006 World Series):

- The St. Louis Cardinals won the 2006 World Series, beating the Detroit Tigers in five games (4–1). It was the franchise's 10th championship. (Sources: sportssurge.alibaba.com, Wikipedia, Baseball-Reference.)
- The series ran from Oct 21 to Oct 27, 2006. (champsorchumps.us)
- The Cardinals clinched with a 4-2 win in Game 5 at Busch Stadium, in which Jeff Weaver outpitched Justin Verlander. (stlredbirds.com)
- David Eckstein was the World Series MVP. (sportssurge.alibaba.com)
- The Cardinals finished the regular season 83–78, the worst record ever for a World Series champion. (Wikipedia)
- It was the Cardinals' first World Series title since 1982. (Baseball-Reference Bullpen)
- Detroit's regular-season record was 95-67. (Baseball-Reference Bullpen)
- The sources did not disagree on any of these points.
